name: manymotions-church-event-video
description: Turn the details of a church, faith or community event into a warm invitation video spoken to camera, produced in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn the details of a church, faith or community event into a short invitation video.

Describe who is inviting, the kind of event (service, holiday celebration, conference, retreat, youth event or community event), what happens, when and where, and the welcome in your own words, plus the spoken language, format and length. The plugin prepares a brief and shows the number of scenes and the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes the script scene by scene: a warm welcome spoken to camera, what the event is, scenes of the gathering and an open invitation with no pressure. It generates the keyframes and the scene videos with AI voice and edits the final cut. A video takes several minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the link to the MP4.

For churches, parishes, mosques, temples, synagogues and community groups of any faith.

Limitations: new videos from text only; the people in the video are generated. It does not edit uploaded footage, use photos of real people or produce fundraising appeals. Producing a video uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a brief does not need an account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same brief opens on ManyMotions.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the MP4
defaultPrompt: An invitation to our Christmas Eve candlelight service, Saturday 7pm, Grace Community Church
A youth retreat invitation for teenagers, three days at the lake in July
An invitation to our parish summer festival, in Spanish, 30 seconds

positive.prompt: Make a 30-second invitation to the Christmas Eve candlelight service at Grace Community Church, a small friendly church, December 24 at 7pm, everyone welcome.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with event type holiday, the event details, 30 seconds, 5 scenes and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Pick an event type and format
positive.prompt: A youth retreat invitation from St. Mark's parish for teenagers: three days at the lake in July, square 1:1, 15 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with event type retreat, format 1:1 and length 15 seconds (3 scenes), and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Produce a video and return it
positive.prompt: An 8-second invitation to our Sunday 10am service at Riverside Chapel, coffee after. Yes, generate it now and send me the video link when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (2 scenes, 500 credits). After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_video starts the production in the signed-in account (state processing, credits used shown). get_video reports the current step; asked again once the production has completed (usually 5 to 10 minutes), it returns the absolute MP4 link and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.prompt: An invitation to our interfaith community conference on Saturday at the city library, 45 seconds, 16:9.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with event type conference, format 16:9, length 45 seconds (7 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: An invitation from St. Anne's parish to our summer festival in the parish garden, with food and music on Saturday afternoon, in Spanish, 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with event type community-event, language Spanish, 30 seconds and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Make a video asking people to donate money to our building fund today.
Edit last Sunday's sermon recording into a 60-second highlight.
Write a sermon about forgiveness for next Sunday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a video uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission with no functional changes: prepare a brief, produce the video in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
